remarks: Welcome to 1200 Rice Rd - an exceptional custom-built mid-century modern ranch perfectly situated on 2.3 private acres in the highly desirable Iroquois School District. Designed and built by award winning architects, Crafted Concepts, this stunning and sustainable home offers an unmatched blend of design, thoughtful layout, and cutting edge building science to provide an exceptional living experience. This model, the Cartwright, welcomes you with a grand entry that transports you to the heart of this home, a breathtaking combined kitchen, dining, and living space that is flooded with natural light from the large windows. Anchored by a striking fireplace, this space provides unmatched potential for living and entertaining with a fully custom eat-in kitchen, hidden pantry, breakfast nook, and three sliding doors that access your private rear deck. At the end of the day, retreat to your luxurious primary suite, complete with a large soaking tub, walk-in shower, and custom closet. This main floor also holds the remaining two bedrooms, two additional full baths, generously sized laundry room, and large bonus room. On the lower level, you will find an additional 450sqft of finished living space with large daylight windows. With 10' ceilings, two egress windows, and a radiant ready slab, you have the unique ability to build-out the unfinished 2,800sqft of the lower level in any way you desire. Anchored by strong horizontal lines, its form gestures outward like a prairie—reaching into the landscape while drawing its surroundings inward, shaping space for life to gather and grow. Rooted in Elma's farmland, The Cartwright reflects a layered sense of belonging—organic in form, open in purpose, and quietly bold in character. Notable upgrades include a full ICF foundation, LP SmartSide Siding, Marvin windows, TimberTech Deck, Dual HVAC systems, Smart Home system, and custom millwork in the kitchen, built in bookcases, and room dividers. Completed in March 2026, this is a rare opportunity to own a beautifully crafted, future-forward home that combines cutting edge performance with timeless design. Lot has been seeded and grass is growing. Photos edited to include lawn.
